We have 2 servers and we typically do if we

modern browsers by default don't allow this
interaction. They block requests being sent
from the client to the server. To be
precise, they don't block it, but they won't
return the response by the server.
This is a security mechanism to make sure
that your JavaScript code that runs in the
browser is only able to talk to your own
server and not to some other server which
